meta.name: wrap-up
meta.description: End-of-session ritual that audits changes, runs quality checks, captures learnings, and produces a session summary. Use when saying "wrap up", "done for the day", "finish coding", or ending a coding session.

copy.tagline: 结束编码会话时自动审计变更、运行质量检查并生成总结
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次编码结束后需要系统性地回顾变更并记录学习心得
copy.tagline_en: Automate change audit, quality checks, and session summary when ending a coding session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic review and learning capture after each coding session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你结束编程会话时，Claude 会自动审查修改的文件、运行质量检查、记录学习心得，并生成一段会话摘要，最后询问你是否准备好结束。
howto.when: 当你说“wrap up”、“done for the day”、“finish coding”等结束编程会话的短语时触发。

say.text: 帮我 wrap up 今天的编码工作。
say.note: Claude 会执行审查、检查、记录并生成摘要。

say.text: 结束会话，记录学习心得。
say.note: Claude 会捕获本次会话的教训和有效模式。

howto.what_en: When you end a coding session, Claude audits changed files, runs quality checks, captures learnings, and produces a session summary, then asks if you're ready to end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "wrap up", "done for the day", "finish coding", or similar phrases to end a coding session.

say_en.note: Claude will audit, check, capture learnings, and summarize.
Claude will record lessons and effective patterns from this session.
